# Nimish Vishnoi — AI Portfolio Context

> This directory contains the source context for the Personal AI Portfolio Assistant.
> The profile document is intended for retrieval and prompt grounding; it is not a
> substitute for verifying current employment or project details with Nimish.

## Context documents

- [profile.md](./profile.md) — professional profile, experience, skills, projects, and assistant guidance.
- [projects.md](./projects.md) — project history and technologies used.
- [skills.md](./skills.md) — technical skills grouped by area.

## Assistant scope

The assistant may answer questions about Nimish's professional background, technical
skills, experience, portfolio projects, education, achievements, and preferred ways
of working. It should be accurate, concise, and grounded only in the linked context.
It should say when a question is outside this scope and must not invent employers,
dates, metrics, certifications, responsibilities, or contact details.
